reviews.review:
Really nice in offline mode, the AI is pretty nice actually compared to most games nowadays, tons of loot, beautiful art direction... I am truly surprised in a good way, derserves more love.
It's a bit long to enter in the game's real action and potential as it sets the story, lore and game mechanics through a long atmospheric tutorial; so please give it time at the beginning before calling it boring, fun will come!
Thanks Arkane Austin for the latest patches, hope you guys will fall on your feet.

EDIT:
I'm a big S.T.A.L.K.E.R. fan and love Ghost Recon Wildlands above most games, but this one can be played solo exactely how you want it; stealth, gunner, both. I really had some insane situations happening to me, from stupid death after having barely survived and close to my goal, having to run for my life after a situation escalated with some vampires in an abandoned railroad track surrounded by kinda cliffs, so no way around but trapped on a straight line, finally escaping this too much closed area, fleeing through the bushes to cross a main road, attracting various factions to the dance, and survived with a lot of sweat.

In higher difficulties, enemies track you way way longer, that's really a manhunt sometimes; I've just (10 mins ago) been followed from a main road to a dried sea zone pretty far away, and as I felt safe down there by the rocks but decided to lounge them, and I did well because a lot of guys did follow me to the edge of the rocks, but didn't penetrate the dried sea, as 3 vampires were already killing some cultist there.

The thing also is that night is way more dangerous than "day" because vampires activity is way higher, almost no sleeping ones or hiding by the environment shadows, they can roam more freely, and altogether with packs of allies (cultists).
So moving at night feels a lot different than by daylight, also a really interesting contrast and change in gameplay. There's actually a lot of subtilities to discover, things have been thought pretty deeply.

What is cool is that there are some interactions within the world between vampires, cultits and another corporation, so when you move forward in the game, the world actually feels more alive as they fight each others, lots of random events...

I started on Dawn difficulty and moved to nightmare just to get feelings back from the very beginning, when you're poorly armed and every single threat is dangerous, and believe me, a lot can happen and it can turn surprising pretty quick.

There's also a lot of verticality, you can access almost all rooftops, there's pretty much always a way to climb up to take advantage of being above things, even if you play Jacob, who can't "teleport" himself or throw himself in the air like Devinder .

Not as bad as everyone makes it. The art and the environment is super good, if you ever wanted to visit a small town with vampires, it's a great place to see. Sure the game is half-baked, but for me personally it's 7/10

This game didn't get a fair shake. Yes buy it on sale. The AI can be a little stupid, the stealth a little janky and the hit boxes still need work. It wasn't terrible. I enjoy the far cry style map exploration and taking over shelters. I never played it in multi player so i cant speak to that but as a solo experience I was expecting so much worse and it turned out to be enjoyable. Would recommend - on sale of course.
The story was pretty good. If you get it on sale then it is very worth it. Once you leave zone 1 you can't go back so think about that when you play.

I got this game a while back around the time of release and I had a rough time even playing it for 30 minutes. It is not the worst game I ever played but its unexpected. Very slow paced not to my liking, The Graphics to me was a set off the trailer and images make it look like it would have amazing graphics but even when I run the game on full graphics it doesn't match the quality expected from the creators of the game.
6/10 and that's begin generous.

Get a 6 pack and anything can be a good time.

Go with a 24 pack for this one. Per play session.
Never got my refund. Thanks for taking my money Steam,Arkane,Bethesda.

its ok now ,but its just  "ok" the start is very slow to build you up on abilities perks and better weapons but its not bad
with all the patches it feels like an ok game to play i personally wouldnt spend full price on it atleast a 70 percent discount would be needed to not feel bad about buying it, i like the setting and the backstory its cool mostly cause it hits on the stuff i like but the gunplay is decent at best the weapons are cool ideas a stake launcher, uv ray gun that petrifies vampires etc
the rarity color system sucks bad its not good
overall its ok but it loses its charm very fast and you can tell the devs didnt really want to make this game it feels so half hearted and bland at times

So... if you like coop this isn't the game for you. You will be INCREDIBLY frustrated when the game refuses to load after 50% completion. Nothing you can do, Bethesda doesn't care,  game is just broke-ass for coop, specifically when you get into the second map. My team ran up a brand-new game and two-for-two the map will not load in coop mode.  So yeah, coop is not for you.
Fun game, nearly no bugs. good performance. Fun with friends

Still unplayable for me. Purchased it to cross-play with my lady and can't even start the first mission with out it just crashing my pc. Trust me, I've done everything to try to get it not to crash. 

I wouldn't recommend till they fix their game.

Got this just to screenshot my name in the Credit cause they left it out initially and fixed it afterwards so the ones on Youtube aren't up to date lmaooo.

But hey, do get this game on sales if it seems interesting to you even after all the backlash. Form your own opinions, its relatively cheap when it does go on sales. Support the last remnant of a great studio killed by Microsoft, they didn't deserve this.

Y'know, I expected to dislike this game more. It's not quite as bad as I thought it was gonna be, but it certainly could've been better. Unfortunately, I cannot in good conscience give this game a positive review. I refuse to encourage Microsoft's horrendous behavior.
